subject: large chest
text: Opening the large chest reveals the Longshot, an upgraded Hookshot that reaches twice as far.

evidence.quote:
open the large chest for the LONGSHOT. It's
an upgraded Hookshot, and reaches twice as far.

subject: blue block
text: Playing the Song of Time removes the blue block behind the chest.

evidence.quote:
Behind the chest is a blue
block. Remove it by playing the Song of Time, and fall through.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found near the third whirlpool in the underground river.

evidence.quote:
Near the third whirlpool is a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS:
079 out of 100)

subject: chest
text: Shooting the gold eye switch with an arrow opens a temporary gate to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
hit the gold eye
switch with an arrow to open the nearby gate temporarily. Take off the Iron
Boots and get to where the gate opened. Open the chest for a SMALL KEY

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located on the ceiling past the west door.

evidence.quote:
Longshot 
to the symbol, and look up at the ceiling to see a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD 
SKULLTULAS: 080 out of 100)

subject: chest
text: Pushing the block until hearing a chime and turning right leads to a chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
push the block until you hear a chime, then turn right. 
Open the chest for a SMALL KEY

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found at the top of the tower.

evidence.quote:
Longshot to the top and look around to see a Gold Skulltula. Longshot
it. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 081 out of 100)

subject: underwater switch
text: Pushing the block until it drops onto the underwater switch raises the water level.

evidence.quote:
push the block the rest of the
way until it drops down to the underwater switch. This'll raise the water.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found in the water after a boulder passes by.

evidence.quote:
Wait until a boulder passes by,
then equip the Iron Boots and go to the water. Get a Gold Skulltula around
here, (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 082 out of 100)

subject: chest
text: Killing the Shell Blade and floating to the top reveals a chest containing the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Kill the
Shell Blade, then float to the top. Open the chest for the BOSS KEY.

subject: Morpha
text: Morpha inflicts three hearts of damage if it grabs Link, and its brain can be snatched away with the Longshot to slash it.

evidence.quote:
if it grabs you, you'll
suffer three hearts of damage. To damage the boss, dodge its attack and its
brain will move around its body. Longshot the brain to snatch it away, and
start slashing it.

subject: Morpha
text: Using the Longshot between slashes prevents Morpha's brain from escaping.

evidence.quote:
To keep the brain from escaping while you're attacking it,
Longshot between slashes and you should take care of it more quickly.

subject: Heart Container
text: Morpha leaves behind a Heart Container after defeat.

evidence.quote:
After the battle, it'll disappear, so grab the HEART CONTAINER then leave
through the light.

subject: Water Medallion
text: Princess Ruto reveals she is the Sage of Water and gives Link the Water Medallion.

evidence.quote:
Back in the Chamber of Sages, Link meets up with Ruto. She
reveals that she's the Sage of Water. ... She'll give you the WATER MEDALLION.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: At night, Longshooting to the tree branch on the island allows Link to get a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Right at the island you are on, make sure it's night, then Longshot to the tree
so you'll stand on its branch. Up here, Longshot the Gold Skulltula on the
tree. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 083 out of 100)

subject: Fire Arrows
text: Shooting an arrow at the rising morning sun from the island's stone quay yields the Fire Arrows.

evidence.quote:
stand on the stone quay on this
island, aim at the sky a little above the two pillars, and wait for morning to
come. As soon as you see the sun coming over the horizon, fire an arrow at
it. If you did it just right, a cinema will show something fall from the sun.
Go over to where it fell and you'll get FIRE ARROWS.

subject: Sun's Song
text: Playing the Sun's Song on the Fire Arrow platform spawns an unbottlable fairy that restores health and magic.

evidence.quote:
If you play the Sun's Song
on this platform where you get the Fire Arrows, a fairy will appear that 
restores health and magic power. You can't bottle the fairy though.

subject: Nocturne of Shadow
text: Sheik teaches Link the Nocturne of Shadow in burning Kakariko Village to enter the Shadow Temple.

evidence.quote:
Once you get there, you'll notice everything is 
on fire. Watch the cinema. After it's over, Sheik will teach you the NOCTURNE 
OF SHADOW, the only way to enter the Shadow Temple.

subject: torches
text: Using Din's Fire on the platform above the Graveyard lights all torches at once to open the Shadow Temple entrance.

evidence.quote:
Play the Nocturne of Shadow and you'll warp to a ledge above the graveyard,
unreachable by other means. Go through the entryway to see a room with a bunch
of torches and a platform. Get on the platform and use Din's Fire. This'll
light all the torches at once and will open the large door.

subject: large chest
text: Defeating the Redead and two Keese reveals a large chest containing the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote:
defeat the
Redead, and the two Keese. Doing this will reveal a large chest containing the
DUNGEON MAP.

subject: large chest
text: Defeating Dead Hand reveals a large chest containing the Hover Boots, which allow hovering over abysses.

evidence.quote:
Go through it and you'll find a Dead Hand, the
same thing you fought at the Bottom of the Well. Defeat it the same way and a
large chest will appear. Open it to get the HOVER BOOTS. These allow you to
hover over an abyss for a very limited time.

subject: bird statue
text: Pushing the bird statue to face the skull statue that does not disappear under the Lens of Truth opens the door ahead.

evidence.quote:
find the skull statue that doesn't disappear. Once you find that one, move the
bird statue by pushing the panel sticking out of it, until the bird is facing
the skull that doesn't disappear. This will open the door ahead.

subject: large chest
text: Defeating the Gibdos behind the fake wall reveals a large chest containing the Compass.

evidence.quote:
Kill the Gibdos to make another large chest
appear. Open it for the COMPASS.

subject: chest
text: Collecting the Silver Rupees in the spinning scythe room opens a cell containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
avoid the large spinning scythe statue, and
collect the Silver Rupees in this room. ... This'll open a small cell with
a chest. Open it for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Killing all Keese and the Like Like opens a cell containing a Gold Skulltula and a chest with a Blue Rupee.

evidence.quote:
There's Keese and a Like Like. ... Once they're all dead, the
cell will open. Inside is a Gold Skulltula and a chest with a Blue Rupee.
(GOLD SKULLTULAS: 084 out of 100)

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is found in the south cell of the dropping spike platforms room.

evidence.quote: At the south cell is a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 085 out of 100)

subject: chest
text: Stepping on the switch at the top portion of the spike room causes a chest to drop containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
step on the switch to make a chest
drop. Go over to it and open it for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula is located behind the skull in the skull room.

evidence.quote:
In here, head behind the skull to find a Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 086
out of 100)

subject: skull
text: Dropping a Bomb or bomb flower into the skull on the upper level releases a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
drop
a Bomb or bomb flower into the skull. Doing this will release a SMALL KEY.

subject: invisible chest
text: Bombing a cracked lump of dirt reveals an invisible chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
check the corners for a lump of dirt with a crack. Bomb it to reveal an
invisible chest. Open it for a SMALL KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Playing Scarecrow's Song and Longshooting to the scarecrow leads to a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
face the ledge on the other side, then play Scarecrow's Song. Long-
shot to the scarecrow, and get the Gold Skulltula. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 087 out of
100)

subject: boat
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem makes the boat move across the room.

evidence.quote:
jump to the boat, and play Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce emblem to
make the boat move.

subject: spiked walls
text: Casting Din's Fire burns away the closing wooden spiked walls.

evidence.quote:
You'll notice that spiked walls are closing in on you. AAHH! But wait, the
walls are made of wood...Equip Din's Fire and use it to burn away those walls.

subject: chest
text: Killing the Redead on the right allows Link to open a chest for the Boss Key.

evidence.quote:
Over
to the right is a different chest. Kill the Redead there, and open the chest
for the BOSS KEY.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing all the skulls on the stairs allows Link to get a Gold Skulltula.

evidence.quote:
Climb up the stairs, and throw bomb flowers into the skulls. ... Once you bomb them all, get the Gold Skulltula here, and go 
back to the previous room. (GOLD SKULLTULAS: 088 out of 100)

subject: chest
text: Killing the invisible Floormaster makes a chest appear containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Kill the invisible Floormaster enemy to make a chest appear.
Open it for a SMALL KEY.

subject: bomb flowers
text: Shooting Fire Arrows at the bomb flowers across the gap collapses the structure to form a bridge.

evidence.quote:
Equip Fire Arrows, and
fire them at the bomb flowers across the gap. This'll weaken the structure by
them and will make it fall, creating a bridge.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: Shooting Bongo Bongo's hands with arrows causes him to ram Link, allowing Link to see him with the Lens of Truth and stun his eye with an arrow.

evidence.quote:
First of
all, you have to arrow its hands. Do so, and the boss will try to ram you.
Use the Lens of Truth to see him, and put an arrow into his eye. This'll stun
him, so go up to him and slash him until he's dead.

subject: Bongo Bongo
text: The Biggoron's Sword with the shield stab technique is effective against Bongo Bongo when he is stunned.

evidence.quote:
The Biggoron's Sword
works best....The Biggoron's Sword with the shield stab technique is your
best friend when he's stunned.

subject: Heart Container
text: Defeating Bongo Bongo causes a Heart Container to appear.

evidence.quote:
After beating this guy, a HEART CONTAINER will appear, and a light. Grab the
Heart, and go into the light.

subject: Shadow Medallion
text: Impa awakens as the Shadow Sage and awards Link the Shadow Medallion.

evidence.quote:
You'll see Impa as the Shadow Sage, and she'll
give you the SHADOW MEDALLION.
